Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

'TTie legs shall be fitted with hard robbei or PVC shoes each of 50 tnm.' 
( Page 3, clause 4.2 ): 

a) Substitute the first and second sentences for the following 

Each dropside cot ( see Fig. 3 ) shall have top ind bottom members consisting 
ot mild steel rods or tubes of 16 mm diameter The ends of the top member shall 
be rounded off ot capped off.' 

b) Add the following at the end of the clause. 

'A hook/catch may be provided to hold the swinging dropside below the mattress 
as an optional fitting/

2.3 Shoes — PVC or bird rubber or any other equally suitable material, uniform ir\ texture and cKem - 
cally inactive to the action of mild acids.

FfC 4 STRIPS CONSTRUCTION SHEET MATTRESS 



4, Manufacture 

4.1 Head and Food Ends — The bows shall be manufactured from mild steel tube and bent as shown m 
Fig, I, wich an outside radius not exceeding 125 mm at the corners Steel plate corner fittings as given 
rn Fig. 2 shall be securely and adequately joined rjo the two bows and the frame so as to provide 
arigid cot when assembled One horizontal cross tube for making the structure of bows rigid, shall 
be welded between the legs of the bows at a height of 475 rnm from the bottom Thereafter six vert>caf 
filling rods spaced at regular intervals shall be welded to the cross tubes and the bows. 

4.1.1 The legs shall be fitted with hard rubber or PVC shoes each of 50 mm diameter secured by screws 
The head -end legs may be provided with castors, 1Q0 mm diameter, at trie option of the purchaser. 

4.2 Drapstdes — Each dropside (see Fig, 3 ) shall have top and bottom members consisting of mjld steel 
rod, 16 mm diameter. The ends of the top member shall be capped off. Each side shall have tl 
vertical filling rods, 8 mm diameter, weeded or riveted to the top and bottom members, the rods being 
equally spaced at regular intervals which will ensure that the gap between two adjacent rods or between 
a rod and the bow of head or foot-end is the same. Two of these rods shall be arranged to slide m 
guides attached to the mattress frame and each shall incorporate a stop-boss Each dropside srnfl bo 
fitted with a safety catch for locking when it is m the upright position The dropsjdes s h 3 1 f be so 
designed as to be capable of being supported by hooks ( or any other suitable arrangerr^nt ) attached to 
the head and foot-ends of the bow and such that the dropsides swing mwards when low;reJ When 
the dropside is lowered to its fullest extent, the top of the top member shall be not more tlnn 100 mm 
above the level of the mattress frame. The cot may be provided with only one dropside at the option 
of the purchaser. 

4.3 Mattress — The mattress frame ( sides and ends ) shall consist oF welded mild steel angfas The 
finished Frame shall be such that any difference between the two diagonals shall not exceed \2 mm. 

4.3.1 For strips construction, each side of the frame shall have 15 holes and each end 8 holes with 
their centres equally spaced from the inner edges of the angles These holes shall be of size and spacing 
to suit the rivets used for riveting of strips to the frame. Eight steel strips for joining to the ends and 
)5 steel strips for joining to the sides of the frame shall be interwoven and riveted to the frame. 
These shall be equally spaced ( see Fig 4 \ and in such a way that the mattress obtained 1^ quite scurdy in 
construcci on. In addition, the frame shall be reinforced by welding or riveting an angle (40 x 40 x 3 
mm ) to the sides of the frame midway between the two ends. 

4.3.1 When using sheet construction, the sheet metal top cut to sue shall be joined to the sides and 
ends of the frame with the three reinforcing stays either by riveting or spot welding ( see Fig. 4 ) In 
either case the spacing of the rivets or spot welds shall be such that the mattress obtained is sturdy in 
construction. Subject to. agreement between the purchaser and the manufacture^ perforated sheet metal 
top may be used Instead if so required; other requirements remaining unaltered- 



5. Finish — Shall conform to 5 of IS : 4033-1968*. 

6. Tests 

6.1 impact Test — For developing impact, a sand bag f 50 kg ) shall be dropped from a height of 300 mm 
over the mattress frame at different points ( one eacn for the sides and one each for two ends ). After 
completion of the test, the frame shall show no sign of mechanical failure. 

6.1 MattressTest — In the first stage an initial load of 10 kg shall be placed at the centre o* the 
mattress and the vertical distance between the mark or? the centre of the mattress and floor 
recorded. Thereafter, the initial load shall be removed and a load consisting of two bags of sand ( each 
weighing 50 kg approximately ) shall be placed on the mattress. This shall be retained for one hour, after 
which this load shall be removed and initial load ( as specified above j replaced back and the measurement 
recorded. The difference between the two measurements shall not be more than 6 mm. 

6. J Adhesion Test — Shah conform to 6.1.1 of tS : 4033-1968*. 

6.4 Performance Test — The cots when fitted with castors shall satisfy the requirements of 6,1.2 of 
IS : 4033-1968*. But when taking the performance test, a total weight of 135 kg shall be distributed 
over tl»e full width. 

7. Marking — Shall be as specified in 7 of IS : 4033- 1968*. 

8. Packing — Shall be as specified m 3 of IS : 4033-1968*
